series.name: Top panel Input power
series.visual_description: Upper dark gray solid curve in the top power panel; gently dips at low-to-mid flow, rises slightly, then falls near the right edge; identified from the legend label “Input power.”
series.axis_selection_reason: The curve is in the top power panel and corresponds to POWER [hp] versus the shared FLOW axis.

series.name: Bottom panel Head
series.visual_description: Blue solid line in the bottom panel descending nearly linearly from high head at zero flow to low head at the far right; identified from the legend label “Head.”
series.axis_selection_reason: The blue curve is plotted against the bottom panel FLOW [l/s] axis and the left HEAD [m] axis.

series.name: Bottom panel Overall efficiency
series.visual_description: Orange solid arch-shaped curve in the bottom panel, lower than the green hydraulic efficiency curve, peaking around mid flow; identified from the legend label “Overall efficiency.”
series.axis_selection_reason: The overall efficiency curve uses the bottom FLOW [l/s] axis and the right-side outer EFF [%] axis.
